stories.summary: “It depends on whether or not they sign a very strong agreement,” Trump told CNN. “The answer is highly unlikely [that] it’s going to be necessary… I would if necessary, but we hit them really hard.”

stories.headline: Police, Health Ministry uncover operation selling methamphetamine labeled as 'khat drops'
stories.summary: Lab tests confirmed that "khat drops" sold in Israel were methamphetamine, police said Sunday. Khat leaves are legal in Israel, but any extract of the plant is illegal.

stories.headline: Iran hardliners demand US ‘pays the price’ before war ends, emboldened by GOP defeat - report
stories.summary: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned against the ‘slightest inclination towards submission,’ a message hardliners believe was aimed at Iran’s negotiators, CNN reported.

stories.headline: Channel 13 reporter suspended for racism after questioning medical credentials of El-Sayed, Tibi
stories.summary: The controversy began when Channel 13 political reporter Eyal Berkovic questioned whether El-Sayed was entitled to use the title "doctor."

stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed Houthi ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said that the ballistic missile launch platform had been used by the Houthis to attack Saudi Arabia.

stories.headline: UNRWA could lay off thousands as Trump’s Board of Peace prepares for post-agency Gaza - report
stories.summary: In a post on September 25, the BoP said it "will only work with trusted partners who will deliver for the people of Gaza and contribute to a deradicalized Strip. UNRWA fails on those litmus tests."

stories.headline: Russian spymaster claims he helped topple Austrian chancellor in Kremlin operation - report
stories.summary: Fugitive Russian spy Jan Marsalek claimed involvement in the 2021 downfall of Austrian chancellor Sebastian Kurz, according to messages seen by The Telegraph.

stories.headline: Official Data Shows 450,000 Russians Killed in War, Death Rate Accelerating – Rosstat Leaks
stories.summary: The war in Ukraine has become the fourth most common cause of death in Russia since 2022, according to official statistics released by hackers.

Russia Says Hit Power Substations in Ukraine and 3 Ships in Black Sea
